description: Screenshot of Q drop #2886 ('New: Title TBD', tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, 24 Feb 2019) as rendered on a Q aggregator. The drop attaches a compilation image about comedian Bill Maher: an IMDbPro listing circling 'Kid Love Productions [us]' as the production company behind three Bill Maher titles, plus three meme panels quoting remarks attributed to Maher about teacher-student sex cases (Debra Lafave, a Seattle schoolteacher) and Michael Jackson. Q's caption reads 'Those who are the loudest.....', insinuating Maher's guilt by association.

description: Still from an HBO 'Real Time with Bill Maher' comedy segment: host Bill Maher, in suit and red striped tie, wears a dark hooded sweatshirt with the hood up and sits at his desk behind an open laptop bearing a large 'Q' sticker, smirking at the camera in a parody of the anonymous 'Q' poster. The show's night-skyline studio backdrop is behind him and a show-branded cup sits at the left edge of frame. Q drop #3398 referenced this segment.

Cropped screenshot of a Q post on 8chan/4chan-style board software, tripcode !ITPb.qbhqo, dated 12/06/17, post No. 46820, with seven reply backlinks above the body. The drop claims an estimated reach of 1.2 million 'Patriots' and gives the doubling sequence '1=2, 2=4, 4=8' to suggest exponential spread, closing 'Godspeed. Q'.
text: >>Q !ITPb.qbhqo 12/06/17 (Wed) 21:33:36 ID: cbaed3 No.46820. >>46903 >>46915 >>46944 >>46952 >>47042 >>47114 >>47362. Reached est 1.2mm, Patriots. You are reaching more than you know. 1=2, 2=4, 4=8, ... Godspeed. Q
flags: The 1.2 million reach figure is the drop's own unverified claim

description: Screenshot of a tweet from account 'TrumpSoldier' (@DaveNYviii) with an embedded video of Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein testifying before a congressional committee, nameplate 'Hon. Rosenstein'. The tweet claims the Inspector General report on the 2016 election and the Hillary Clinton investigation contains 1.2 million documents with a production date of January 15, 2018, tagged #RosensteinHearing. The video player shows 2,096 views at 1:41 of 1:51. Q post 340 paired this 1.2 million figure with the '1.2mm Patriots' drop.
text: TrumpSoldier. @DaveNYviii. Following. The Inspector General Report into the 2016 Election and the Hillary Clinton Investigation contains 1.2 Million documents. Production date: January 15th, 2018 #RosensteinHearing. Hon. Rosenstein. 2,096 views. 1:41 / 1:51
flags: The 1.2 million documents figure and production date are the tweet's claim
Aides seated behind Rosenstein are private individuals and are not identified

description: 'Q proof' graphic headlined 'DO YOU BELIEVE IN COINCIDENCE?' assembling three items dated 9 Jul 2019 — a New York Times article by Adam Goldman on Michael Flynn changing his story, a Sara A. Carter tweet on a judge rejecting the DOJ's 'coconspirator' label for Flynn, and a Donald Trump tweet embedding a Fox News Hannity clip on the same ruling — all connected by red lines to a boxed Q drop (No.6958686, 07/08/19, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI) reading 'FLYNN news coming. Q'. The layout argues the drop predicted the next day's Flynn news; the archive records this as the graphic's claim.
